exposure: COVID-19 infection during pregnancy (first vs. second wave)
outcome: neonatal outcomes (NICU admission, other unspecified outcomes)
cohort: 144 COVID-19 positive pregnant women admitted to a dedicated COVID-19 Hospital under Tomo Riba Institute of Health and Medical Sciences (TRIHMS) in Itanagar, Arunachal Pradesh, India between July 2020 and August 2021.
finding: A significantly greater number of pregnant women experienced severe COVID-19 morbidity and mortality during the second wave compared to the first wave.
